# ceph_user (Data Source)

Reads a Ceph Dashboard user account by username.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ceph_user" "admin" {
  username = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Dashboard username to look up.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled.
- `last_update` (Number) Unix timestamp of the user's last update.
- `name` (String) Full name of the user.
- `pwd_expiration_date` (Number) Password expiration date as a Unix timestamp.
- `pwd_update_required` (Boolean) Whether the user must change their password on next login.
- `roles` (Set of String) Dashboard role names granted to the user.
